عننت (form I)
# عَنَنْتُ (ʕanantu) /ʕa.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of عَنَّ (ʕanna)
# عَنَنْتَ (ʕananta) /ʕa.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of عَنَّ (ʕanna)
# عَنَنْتِ (ʕananti) /ʕa.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of عَنَّ (ʕanna)
